summary: The change replaces the repository's single binary asset, icon.dat, with a different binary payload, so any consumer of that file now receives different bytes while the exact semantic intent of the new payload is not derivable from the bounded evidence.

items.title: The binary file icon.dat was replaced
items.statement: Across d7468c1..f66dfed, icon.dat remains at the same path and mode (100644) but its blob changed from 85025d98693fe77b700bcf818dfd8fcd13c4e961 to 4bf941a61efbd197352e63126c8b27701fe8ff3c, indicating a direct binary content replacement.

items.title: Reads of icon.dat now return a different binary payload
items.before: Any process reading icon.dat obtained the prior payload identified by blob 85025d98693fe77b700bcf818dfd8fcd13c4e961.
items.after: The same read now yields the replacement payload identified by blob 4bf941a61efbd197352e63126c8b27701fe8ff3c.

items.title: The functional meaning of the new binary payload is not derivable from bounded evidence
items.statement: Because the changed unit is binary and the evidence includes no decoded or source-level semantics, the specific visual or runtime meaning of the replacement content cannot be determined from this evidence set alone.
